lessonsProposed: The Playwright MCP toolset available to QA has no key-press, evaluate or route tool, so Tab traversal, in-game jumps and per-frame measurements cannot be browser-verified there; a same-origin media route can be emulated with a scratch reverse proxy on the test port.
